recentItems.title: Alix Earle, Ashtin Earle Test Positive for BRCA2 After Mom's Cancer | E! News
recentItems.description:
Months after Alix Earle and Ashtin Earle’s mom Alisa Maniaci was diagnosed with breast cancer, the sisters got tested for the BRCA2 gene during ‘Earle Meets World.’ In an emotional scene, genetic counselor Pankti Doshi revealed that both sisters tested positive for the genetic change in BRCA2. After hearing the results, Alisa tearfully apologized to her daughters, believing she had passed the gene down to them, but Alix, 25, and Ashtin, 23, quickly reassured their mom. The family explained at the premiere of ‘Earle Meets World’ Sept. 1 that they wanted to share those raw, personal moments with viewers. In fact, as they were learning the results, "I didn't really think much about the cameras," Alix told E!'s Erin Lim Rhodes, "because we were so focused on each other and just being there and supporting each other." recentItems.title: Wheel of Fortune's Jim Thornton Was Allegedly in Pedophile Chat on Plane | E! News
recentItems.description:
This story discusses child sexual abuse content. More details are coming to light about the incident that led to Jim Thornton's exit. After Wheel of Fortune suspended its longtime announcer on Sept. 1 over undisclosed allegations from an American Airlines flight, the passenger involved in the May incident told TMZ that she saw messages on his computer that made it seem like he was in a chat room for pedophiles. The outlet obtained photos allegedly showing Thornton's computer on his tray table with messages in a chat room discussing "a couple of cute boys and a hot little girl" as well as "CP," which the passenger believes stood for child pornography. Other messages in the chat room read, "saunters to the bathroom for a quick w--k on the 737" and "does it count as the mile high club if its a h---job?" per the photos. It's unclear if Thornton was the one who sent any of the messages. Thornton's lawyer Allison Hart told TMZ that the chat room is “not unlawful" and "there is no unlawful child pornography or other pedophilic content." She added, "My client never viewed, downloaded or consumed any child pornography whether on that commercial flight in May or at any other time.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435740/wheel-of-fortunes-jim-thornton-denies-pedophile-chat-room-plane-messages

recentItems.title: Kim Zolciak's Son KJ Biermann Indicted on 7 Charges in Assault Case | E! News
recentItems.description:
Kroy "KJ" Biermann Jr.'s case is moving forward. The 15-year-old son of Kim Zolciak and Kroy Biermann was indicted Sept. 3 on seven counts following his Aug. 17 arrest, including aggravated child molestation, aggravated sexual battery, aggravated sodomy, sexual battery against a child under 16 and false imprisonment, according to court documents obtained by E! News. A grand jury from Fulton County, Ga., validated the charges, which allege that KJ "did unlawfully commit an immoral and indecent act" with a "child under the age of 16 years" on April 23, among other acts related to sexual assault. KJ’s attorney Jason Sheffield responded to the indictment in a statement to E!, where he maintains KJ’s innocence. The lawyer said the indictment "cannot tell us the whole truth of a case" because he has not yet presented his evidence, saying, "Without DNA evidence, the case remains one of 'she said, he said' and the credibility of the accuser. The evidence that I have gathered will prove, at the appropriate time and place, that KJ Biermann is not guilty of these horrific allegations." Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435737/kim-zolciaks-son-kj-biermann-indicted-on-7-charges-in-sexual-assault-case

recentItems.title: Jason Kelce Is Unrecognizable Without a Beard in Resurfaced Photos | E! News
recentItems.description:
Jason Kelce is throwing a flag on some old college photos. Ahead of the former Philadelphia Eagles center’s induction into his alma mater University of Cincinnati’s Hall of Fame, he had a hairy feeling about his grooming style during his days on the Bearcats’ football team. “I just hate the way my face looks without a beard,” Jason said on the Sept. 2 episode of his 'New Heights' podcast while looking at photos of his and brother Travis Kelce’s college team huddled up during a game. “Is that what I look like when I’m yelling? Is that how it always looks?” Of course, Jason has traded in his old playbook and now sports a full beard, which is actually the only look his wife Kylie Kelce has ever known. “That would absolutely freak me out,” the 'Not Gonna Lie' host said on the Aug. 31 episode of her podcast. “I’ve never met his chin, I’ve never seen his chin in person. We’ve never met. Rumor has it that there’s a little bit of the butt chin under there. I don’t know though; I’ve never met it. That’d be kind of fun to find out.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435735/jason-kelce-looks-so-different-without-his-beard-photos

recentItems.title: Carla Jeffery's Family Responds to Claim Drugs Were Involved in Death | E! News
recentItems.description:
Carla Jeffery’s family is clearing up misinformation.  Shortly after the Disney star’s management shared she died Sept. 1 at the age of 33, Jeffery’s family refuted rumors that drugs were involved.  A family spokesperson told TMZ that Jeffery died in her California home, adding, “She did not do drugs.” The spokesperson also stated that the police were not conducting an investigation, and that the family would be awaiting the results of an autopsy before going public with further information. The Zombies actress’ death was confirmed by her longtime manager in an Instagram post Sept. 1, where many of her costars took to the comments to pay tribute. recentItems.title: Lindsay Clancy’s Lawyer Accuses One Juror of Holding Up Verdict | E! News
recentItems.description:
Lindsay Clancy’s attorney is asking for the removal of a juror. As deliberations continued on whether the 36-year-old is criminally responsible for the 2023 deaths of her three young children, Clancy’s attorney Kevin Reddington requested that judge William F. Sullivan remove one member of the jury on Sept. 3. He accused the juror of “refusing to listen” to the judge’s instructions about reasonable doubt in the case and holding up the verdict in the murder case. Reddington told the judge according to a video from the trial posted to YouTube by USA Today, “The court has an instruction from the foreperson of that juror that's been working for a week now, saying that there's one juror who refuses to listen to the law that you've given him or her on reasonable doubt. I suggest, respectfully, that the soft instruction that you gave them, saying at the sidebar, ‘Can you listen to the law as I instruct you?’ does not focus on the issue.” He continued, “The question is not sufficient enough. It does not allow any foundation for a motion to remove the juror who refuses to accept your instructions on the law on reasonable doubt.” Reddington noted that if the jury were to come back with a mistrial “because of a juror that has just spurned the instructions of this court, it's a shame.” Clancy is charged with three counts of first-degree murder, and while she has not denied that she killed her and then-husband Patrick Clancy’s children Cora, 5, Dawson, 3, and Callan, 8 months, on Jan. 24, 2023 at their home in Duxbury, Mass., she had pleaded not guilty to the charges of murder and strangulation. During previous deliberations on both Sept. 1 and Sept. 2, the jury said they had been unable to reach a consensus and remained deadlocked. The judge urged the jurors to reconsider their positions to avoid a hung jury and a mistrial. Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435732/lindsay-clancy-juror-removal-requested-holding-up-trial-verdict-lawyer
